main_body: grey stone mortar bowl with a green-filled opening and a brown pestle leaning out of it
top_band: light grey rim ellipse with green paste inside, rows ~7-10, about 3 rows tall
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: the light grey rim and green paste ellipse at rows ~7-10 show the inside of the opening from above. Below it is a lighter rim edge, then a darker grey rounded bowl body over a dark foot, rows ~11-14. The opening is a small ellipse, but the rim is short and the body is clearly a vertical bowl, so it reads as a 3/4 container, though only marginally.

style.evidence: The grey bowl body is a fairly flat mid-grey with a dark base and only a few highlight pixels on the rim. Its outline leans dark blue-grey and near-black in places. The green paste and the brown pestle have 2-3 steps each, with little grain. Next to the Beodeul stall and well, with their 5-6 step ramps and per-element texture, it looks thinner and flatter, and the stone body has a flat-fill area.
